author: THSV StreamBridge
description: Turns matching Twitch, YouTube, Kick, TikTok, Streamlabs, and Ko-fi events into saved stream labels ready for OBS.
changelog: 4.1.65: aligned with THSV StreamBridge 4.1.65, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. 2.5.1: initial release with bounded latest-value persistence, multi-platform semantic grouping, simulator-safe previews, individual browser-source selectors, and a combined label panel.

manifest.name: Stream Labels
installationSteps: Install and enable Stream Labels. No separate Streamer.bot import or direct trigger is required.
Choose the platforms, label groups, and simple visual style in the wizard.
Copy one individual label URL or the combined preview URL into an OBS, Meld, or Streamlabs browser source.
Use the normal StreamBridge simulator to verify mappings before going live.
uninstallationSteps: Uninstall the add-on. Its latest label values remain preserved for a later reinstall.

healthChecks.description: Checks that the latest events are saved and reach the Stream Labels overlay.
